call: ^Agent 0x00. I'd ask how the leave was, but HaX would tell me to get off her line.

c-0: ^I'd rather be useful than watched. Tonight I get to be both.

g-0: ^Every lock is a promise somebody made years ago. Most of them forget they made it. Goodnight, 0x00.
^Agent HaX: He's right. I hate that he's right.
